details.question: Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
details.sql:
SELECT
  e.event_id,
  e.event_name,
  SUM(b.spent) as total_spent,
  SUM(b.amount) as total_budget,
  ROUND(SUM(b.spent)::NUMERIC / SUM(b.amount)::NUMERIC, 2) as spend_budget_ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'closed'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY spend_budget_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1
